Wildfire Mitigation Cost Guide — Western States 2026

Typical costs for defensible space clearing, home hardening, and fire-resistant landscaping by state and service type.

Defensible Space Clearing Costs by State

Defensible space clearing costs depend on property size, vegetation type and density, terrain slope, and how much clearing has been done previously. The following ranges represent typical costs for a standard 1-acre property in each state.

StateAvg. Clearing Cost (1 acre)High-Risk SurchargeAnnual Maintenance
California$2,800 – $8,500+20–40% in VHFHSZ zones$800 – $2,500/yr
Colorado$2,200 – $7,000+15–30% in WUI zones$600 – $2,000/yr
Oregon$2,000 – $6,500+15–25% in high-risk zones$500 – $1,800/yr
Washington$1,800 – $6,000+10–20% in SRA zones$500 – $1,600/yr
Montana$1,500 – $5,500+10–20% in high-risk areas$400 – $1,400/yr
Idaho$1,400 – $5,000+10–15% in WUI zones$400 – $1,200/yr
Arizona$1,600 – $5,500+15–25% in high-risk zones$450 – $1,500/yr
New Mexico$1,400 – $5,000+10–20% in high-risk areas$400 – $1,300/yr

Home Hardening Costs

Home hardening involves upgrading the structure itself to resist ember intrusion and radiant heat. Costs vary significantly based on the age of the home, existing materials, and the scope of upgrades required.

Upgrade TypeTypical CostPriority Level
Ember-resistant vent covers$300 – $1,200🔴 Critical
Class A fire-rated roofing$8,000 – $25,000🔴 Critical
Dual-pane tempered glass windows$3,000 – $12,000🟠 High
Non-combustible deck replacement$5,000 – $20,000🟠 High
Exterior wall siding upgrade$8,000 – $30,000🟡 Medium
Garage door sealing$500 – $2,000🟠 High
Full home hardening package$8,000 – $35,000Varies

Grants & Rebates Available

Several state and federal programs offer financial assistance for wildfire mitigation work. Eligibility varies by state, income level, and property location.

  • California: CAL FIRE Grants Program — up to $5,000 for qualifying homeowners
  • Colorado: Colorado Wildfire Risk Reduction Program — cost-share grants available
  • Oregon: Oregon ODF Defensible Space Program — technical assistance and rebates
  • Federal: USDA Forest Service — community wildfire defense grants
